spec.name: Halloween Pocket Ghost Lantern
spec.description: An open iron lantern with a copper crown, orange carrying loop and a tiny mint-white ghost suspended inside. A stepped ghost hem and painted face give it a friendly Halloween silhouette. Axis-aligned, with transparent openings and no animation.

prompt: Handheld iron and copper lantern containing a little mint-white ghost, orange hanging handle. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
